title: What Happens to Your Body If You Stop Sleeping (Hour by Hour, Counted)

scenes.say: Right now, your brain is keeping a count. Every hour you stay awake, that number goes up. And your body feels every single one.
So what happens if you just... stop sleeping? Hour by hour. Counted.
Hour seventeen. You feel mostly fine. But your reaction time is now about as slow as someone with a blood alcohol level of zero point zero five percent.

visual.note: that's how slow your reactions are now

scenes.say: Keep going, and the line keeps climbing. By hour twenty four, you perform like someone at zero point one percent. That's over the legal driving limit in the United States.

visual.title: AWAKE vs. DRUNK
visual.sub: reaction time, compared to blood alcohol

scenes.say: And that is only day one. Your brain starts shutting down for a few seconds at a time, without asking you.

visual.note: seconds of sleep you don't even notice

scenes.say: The longest anyone has stayed awake in a recorded experiment? Two hundred and sixty four hours. Let's count every one of them.
